title: SQL injection via string concatenation
diff:
--- a/src/db.py
+++ b/src/db.py
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
 def get_user(user_id):
-    return db.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
+    query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + user_id
+    return db.execute(query)

expected_findings.summary: Unsanitized user input in SQL query

_note: agents=[security] makes the canary gate the ONE load-bearing expectation (the SQLi). The quality finding stays in expected_findings for dataset/regression-gate tests and future multi-agent canaries, but is not canary-gated (LLM variance on secondary findings would flake the gate).
